q: any moves I can make to give me more scoring in Fantasy points for tomorrow? It looks like my chances of winning are low becuase of the score differntial tomorrow and it owuld be nice to get a few more players (if possible) where the drops and adds would clear in time, players who play tomorrow for players who do not, but still allow the players who I am dropping to play today? Possible or not? make sure you give me the correct answer.
short: Partly possible. Free agents are instant, so you can add Saturday players in time, but anyone you drop who plays today only keeps his points if you drop him after his game, which means Saturday morning before tip-off. The one clean swap to make now is Wiggins for Mitchell Robinson.
answer:
Short version: yes, but with a timing catch. Saturday (tomorrow) is your weak day: only Pritchard, Hart and Bridges play, about 81.9 projected points, versus about 321.5 for Angel Reese (Wembanyama, LaMelo, Embiid, Towns, George). That leaves 8 of your 11 slots empty on Saturday. The week is closer than the daily numbers look, though. Projected totals are 1630.5 for you and 1709.2 for them, a gap of about 79, and you project 340.3 on Sunday against their 161.2.

Roster room: you have 15 active players (the max is 15) and both IR spots are used by Edwards and Morant. Both are listed OUT, so they belong there, and there is no free spot. Every add needs a drop.

Timing: free agents are instant. Waiver claims take 24 hours and the only Saturday-relevant waiver player, Derik Queen (NO, 30.5 per game), clears Saturday 2 AM. Almost every useful Saturday player is a plain free agent, so they can be added any time before that player's tip-off. Lineups lock daily, and a player whose game has started can't be moved or dropped. I'm fairly sure ESPN also blocks dropping a player once his game has tipped, so a player who plays tonight can't reliably be dropped tonight. If you drop him before tip-off today, you lose his Friday points. So the only way to drop a Friday player and keep his Friday points is to wait until the day rolls over, which should be Saturday morning, and do the drop and add before the Saturday games tip. I can't verify ESPN's exact rollover time from the data, so check that the drop button is live before you rely on it.

The cleanest swap right now: Andrew Wiggins (MIA) only plays Sunday, so he has no Friday points to lose, and he projects 24.8 for the rest of the week. Mitchell Robinson (BOS, free agent, C, 30.3 per game) plays Saturday and Sunday, so he projects about 60. Swapping them adds roughly 35 points and keeps Sunday's lineup full.

Other Saturday free agents: Ryan Rollins (MIL, PG/SG, 31.9, Saturday only) is the best one. After that come Isaiah Stewart (MEM, 25.3), Scoot Henderson (POR, 25.4), Keaton Wagler (LAC, 24.4) and Santi Aldama (DAL, 25.0, Saturday and Sunday). To make room for them you would have to drop someone. Jaylen Brown is OUT with a hamstring strain, and I found no return date (the latest report was around Nov 17, and I found nothing after that). He is also on your bench with 0 projected points this week, but at 38.6 per game he is better than any free agent, and the only IR spots are full. I would not drop him unless you want to chase this week at the cost of next month.

The aggressive option: Friday-only players (Randle 37.0, Allen 36.9) have nothing left this week once they play tonight. If you drop one Saturday morning for Rollins, you gain about 32 points this week and lose about 5 points per game after that. I would only do that if you accept that tradeoff. Be aware that a dropped player may go onto waivers instead of being instantly re-addable.

Honest odds: even with every possible add you won't close Saturday's 240-point gap on Saturday itself, but the week gap is only about 79 and Sunday favors you by about 180, so the Wiggins swap plus one more stream is worth doing. Edwards news: I found nothing dated this season, only spring 2026 items, so treat his timeline as unknown.

moves.do: Now: drop Andrew Wiggins, add Mitchell Robinson (BOS, free agent, instant)
moves.why: Wiggins has no Friday game and only Sunday (24.8 projected); Robinson plays Saturday and Sunday at 30.3 per game, about +35 for the week.

moves.do: Saturday morning before tip-off: drop Randle (or Allen) after his Friday game is banked and add Ryan Rollins (MIL)
moves.why: Rollins projects 31.9 on Saturday when you have 8 empty slots; it costs about 5 FP per game of long-term value.
